init.title: Configure Child Entity Mappings
init.description:
Map each input to a child media player entity for streaming and media control. This allows zones to delegate play/pause, and media info to other media players while retaining direct volume/mute control. Leave unmapped for basic receiver functionality.

Configured zones: {zones}
